name_zh: 巴切莱特/智利/女性/医生/社会/养老金/米歇尔/温和/改革
description_zh: 米歇尔·巴切莱特 (1951-) 智利总统 (2006-2010, 2014-2018) 第一位女总统，医生出身，推行社会改革、养老金制度改革、教育改革、性别平等立法，倡导温和改革，推动智利社会现代化，被誉为 "社会改革者", 对拉美性别政治产生深远影响。
description_en: Michelle Bachelet (1951-) Chilean President (2006-2010, 2014-2018) first female president, doctor by profession, promoted social reform, pension system reform, education reform, gender equality legislation, advocated moderate reform, promoted Chilean social modernization, known as "social reformer", had profound impact on Latin American gender politics.
reason_zh: 巴切莱特代表拉美女性领导人如何通过社会改革实现国家现代化，如何通过性别平等立法推动社会进步，以及如何通过温和改革实现政治转型，体现了拉美民主转型的进步性。
reason_en: Bachelet represents how Latin American female leaders achieve national modernization through social reform, promote gender equality through legislation, and achieve political transformation through moderate reform, embodies progressiveness of Latin American democratic transition.
